parse.title: Professor Robot
parse.text:
Professor Robot
Type
NPC
Quests
Now there's Robots?
Description
Allows the player to access the  Sapphire Crystal after giving them robot parts.
Location
 Lost Precursor City

Professor Robot is an NPC located in the  Lost Precursor City. He grants the player access to the  Sapphire Crystal.

Contents

  • 1 Quest
  • 2 Dialogue
  • 3 History
  • 4 Navigation

Quest

[edit | edit source]

In order to obtain the  Sapphire Crystal, Professor Robot must be given the following items:

  •  Electron Transmitter
  •  FTX 3070
  •  Robotron Reflector
  •  Superlite Motor
  •  Control Switch
  •  Synthetic Heart

Or

  •  Precursor Apparatus

They cost a total of ??? coins or ??? coins respectively.

Dialogue

[edit | edit source]
Condition Dialogue
First Interaction
[NPC] Professor Robot: This citadel used to be the epicenter of fructuous engineering.
[NPC] Professor Robot: The inhabitants, Precursors, as they were once called, laid the foundations for the future.
[NPC] Professor Robot: However, they have been extinct for eons - only leaving the remnants of the Automatons behind.
[NPC] Professor Robot: One rather peculiar discovery is the Automaton Prime - the giant robot towering above me. The exact purpose of it is unknown, although it appears to be guarding something.
[NPC] Professor Robot: There seems to be 6 key components to the giant that are missing.
[NPC] Professor Robot: Each part - the Electron Transmitter, FTX 3070, Robotron Reflector, Superlite Motor, Control Switch, and a Synthetic Heart plays a distinctive role in the creation of this behemoth.
[NPC] Professor Robot: I think the Automatons nearby are built with similar components. Find them and bring them to me!
Without a Component
This dialogue varies depending on items already given.
[NPC] Professor Robot: That's not one of the components I need! Bring me one of the missing components:
Electron Transmitter
FTX 3070
Robotron Reflector
Superlite Motor
Control Switch
Synthetic Heart
Giving a Component
[NPC] Professor Robot: Thanks for bringing me the <Component>! Bring me <missing count> more components to fix the giant!
Giving a Component that was already given
[NPC] Professor Robot: You have already delivered that part to me! Bring me a unique robot part!
Given All 6 Components
[NPC] Professor Robot: You've brought me all of the components!
[NPC] Professor Robot: I have uploaded them to the giant below...it appears it has opened its storage compartment!
[NPC] Professor Robot: Perhaps the long-lost Sapphire Crystal is in there!
Giving a  Precursor Apparatus
[NPC] Professor Robot: That's not one of the compon-
[NPC] Professor Robot: Wait a minute. This will work just fine.
[NPC] Professor Robot: I have uploaded this to the giant below...it appears it has opened its storage compartment!
[NPC] Professor Robot: Perhaps the long-lost Sapphire Crystal is in there!
Given 5 Components with  Mole Pet's perk activating
[NPC] Professor Robot: You've brought me all of the components... I think? To be honest, I kind of lost count...
[NPC] Professor Robot: I have uploaded them to the giant below...it appears it has opened its storage compartment!
[NPC] Professor Robot: Perhaps the long-lost Sapphire Crystal is in there!
After Obtaining Sapphire Crystal
[NPC] Professor Robot: You haven't placed the Sapphire Crystal yet!
[NPC] Professor Robot: Go to the Crystal Nucleus to place it!
